spec2def(msftedit.dll msftedit.spec)

# msftedit.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/msftedit-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(msftedit_shims OBJECT msftedit_main.c)
target_link_libraries(msftedit_shims PRIVATE uuid wine libriched20 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(msftedit_shims)
add_cargo_module(msftedit msftedit-cargo msftedit.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS msftedit_shims psdk uuid_sources)
